Level 2 · Mastering arc42

Level 2: Mastering arc42

Document one real system with the arc42 template, section by section, with a lab on your own document and a worked example you can read and run.

Open the courseSee pathways

Live online course US$129

Who it is for
Engineers, architects and tech leads who must leave a system understandable to the next team, and teams that want documentation that stays alive.
Before you start
Level 1 is recommended, not required. You need a system you know well enough to describe.
Capstone evidence
A complete arc42 document for one system, with its decisions and risks recorded.
How it is assessed
Recall questions in every lesson, timed exercises, and a lab with health checks. The certificate shows you finished the course.

Modules and evidence

Each module ends in an artefact that goes into your record.
